challenges.says: The first criterion says the files are handed on as parsed documents, but integrations.decision-3 has the API hand the file text to the parsers in the domain, so parsing is not part of what the folder read hands on.

The last criterion drops the cited rule's condition that the earlier top row is put back only when the policy is in the same category, and its stated consequence that the policy is not guaranteed to stay in view.
A person who never saw the code cannot follow the undefined word "orphaned" in the icon criterion, nor "the right pane" and "the information pane".

The first criterion states loading under a fresh temporary name after the backup and restore rights are switched on, which comes from businessrule-50808386816006011599, yet it cites only integrations.decision-2.
